summary: P0-C Fix verification: EditorialOverridesProvider locale-aware fix tested. All 4 scenarios PASS. context_for_next_testing_agent: P0-C fix in EditorialOverridesProvider.jsx VERIFIED COMPLETE. Fix correctly: 1) Uses useLocaleRuntime() to get localeCode 2) Derives base lang (IT_IT→'it', EN_US→'en') 3) Calls /api/editorial-copy/runtime?locale=<correct_lang> 4) Re-fetches on locale switch via deps [localeCode, localeProp]. Pre-existing issues: 'nav.client_relations_accounts' token visible on CRM page (missing key). Dashboard shows Italian static strings in EN mode (separate issue, not CMS overrides).
rca_of_issue: PRE-FIX: EditorialOverridesProvider used hardcoded 'it' as default locale for the API call, meaning EN/FR/DE users always loaded Italian CMS overrides (e.g., nav.new_journey='Inizia il tuo viaggio' shown to EN users). POST-FIX: Provider reads localeCode from LocaleRuntimeContext (e.g., 'EN_US'), splits on '_', lowercases to get 'en', calls /api/editorial-copy/runtime?locale=en which returns correct EN overrides. The useEffect deps include [localeCode, localeProp] so switching locale re-triggers the fetch. Fix is minimal (1 file) and correct.
